en.t: At the Oi residence, it was not convenient for him to go often.

units.source_text: 只有赴嵯峨佛堂念佛之时，乘便去访，每月欢会两次而已。

en.t: Only when he went to the Buddhist hall at Saga to chant prayers would he visit her on the way, and their joyful meetings were no more than twice a month.

units.source_text: 比较起牛郎织女来，差胜一筹。

en.t: Compared with the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl, they were at least a little better off.

units.source_text: 明石姬虽然不敢再有奢望，但心中安得不伤离怨别？

en.t: Although the Lady of Akashi no longer dared to hope for more, how could her heart not ache with the sorrow and resentment of separation?
